layout.007: A project in development. Better continuity for your building.
accueil.004: Documents, maintenance, decisions: bring your building’s life together.
accueil.011: A building is more than an address.
accueil.012: It has residents, equipment, contracts and decisions made over the years. Domolyma connects them so you can recover the context and keep things moving.
accueil.014: A document vault to organise, filter and view your building’s records.
accueil.016: Reports, maintenance, equipment and contracts, with their context.
accueil.018: From general meeting preparation to documented decisions and the actions that follow.
accueil.025: Everyone can access what concerns them.
accueil.026: Plan maintenance, view a document, follow a report or find a decision: roles and links to units determine access.
accueil.031: Discover what the alpha offers today and what is still to come.
accueil.036: The façade of a residential building, with a pattern of windows and balconies
fonctionnalites.004: From records to decisions, a continuous thread to see where your building stands.
fonctionnalites.005: The features described are available in the alpha, with the limitations set out below.
fonctionnalites.013: Gallery or list, filters and previews: documents stay connected to their building and related records.
fonctionnalites.016: Viewing and downloading according to permissions
fonctionnalites.025: An illustration of document organisation, with no real data.
fonctionnalites.029: Keep the facts, evidence and follow-up together.
fonctionnalites.030: Describe a situation, link it to a place or equipment, assign follow-up and find the discussion in its record. Contracts, visits and equipment add to the building’s memory.
fonctionnalites.034: Automatic deadlines and advanced notifications are still to be completed.
fonctionnalites.038: Gather the meeting documents, distinguish a proposal from a documented outcome, then track actions and deadlines.
fonctionnalites.040: The expected documents and where they came from.
fonctionnalites.042: Its status, reservations and supporting documents.
fonctionnalites.045: Full general meeting proceedings, voting and final minutes are still to be implemented.
fonctionnalites.050: Compare planned amounts with invoices, view estimates by unit and prepare service charge simulations.
fonctionnalites.052: Keep private rental contacts, rental periods and bookings in a calendar.
fonctionnalites.053: Full accounting, issuing payment calls, rent receipts and lease generation are not available in this alpha.
fonctionnalites.058: Organise records, prepare decisions and follow actions according to their permissions.
fonctionnalites.060: View shared information and information related to their units.
fonctionnalites.062: Access the information needed for their work and record visits according to the permissions granted.
fonctionnalites.065: The project and its next steps
projet.004: Domolyma is building a shared living record for properties and the people who look after them.
projet.007: A building lasts for years. Its information should too.
projet.008: People change, contracts evolve and maintenance work follows on. The project connects records so decisions can be found and actions continued without starting again.
projet.009: Shared property management comes first. Rental records and an overview of several properties build on that foundation.
projet.015: Buildings and units, versioned documents, reports, equipment, contracts, meeting preparation, documented decisions, indicative budgets and an initial rental record.
projet.018: The full shared-account lifecycle, meetings and voting, condominium accounting, payment calls, notifications and automatic deadlines.
projet.021: A fully fictional building to explore workflows, switch roles and start again freely.
projet.025: The presentation distinguishes alpha features from future work. Indicative budgets and simulations do not amount to full accounting.
projet.026: The demo uses entirely fictional examples. Records for real buildings remain separate.
